[[Kuala Lumpur FA|Kuala Lumpur]] was relegated at the end of the [[2012 Liga Super]] season after finishing in the bottom place of the league table. [[Sarawak FA|Sarawak]], [[Sabah F.C. (Malaysia)|Sabah]] and [[Kedah FA|Kedah]] were also relegated after losing the playoffs. [[2012 Liga Premier]] champions [[ATM FA|Angkatan Tentera Malaysia]] secured direct promotion to the Liga Super.
